description:
With just 93 seconds left in the third period of a tied Game 6 in the Second Round, Gustav Forsling scored the series-winning goal, propelling the Florida Panthers past the Boston Bruins. Joining the rush and receiving a pass near center ice, Forsling moved the puck to Anton Lundell and drove the middle lane. After Lundell's initial shot was stopped, the rebound bounced out, and Forsling pounced on it, sending a wrist shot into the back of the net. The defenseman, who led all players in plus-minus during the regular season, also led all Panthers skaters in that category during the 2024 Stanley Cup Playoffs.

description:
Facing elimination in Game 6 of the Western Conference Second Round against Vancouver, Dylan Holloway gets on the board early for the Oilers. description:
In Game 1 of the Western Conference Final, Connor McDavid scored the game-winning goal in the second overtime, stunning the Dallas crowd and top-seeded Stars. The play began with a strong forecheck by Ryan Nugent-Hopkins, who chipped the puck around the boards. It went directly to Evan Bouchard, who found McDavid alone in the slot. Bouchard immediately passed to McDavid, who redirected the puck into the net. This marked McDavid’s second career playoff goal and his first in the second overtime frame.

description:
In the final moments of a tense, goalless Game 6, it was Pius Suter who sealed the series for Vancouver. With less than two minutes remaining in the third period, the puck was sent around the boards to Brock Boeser behind the net. Sensing the opportunity, Suter dashed towards the net. Boeser executed a quick turnaround pass, connecting perfectly with Suter, who wasted no time burying the puck into the back of the net. This lone goal propelled Vancouver into the second round of the Stanley Cup Playoffs.

description:
Every player dreams of netting a Game 7 overtime goal, and David Pastrnak turned that dream into reality in a thrilling matchup against the Toronto Maple Leafs, a classic Original Six showdown. Pastrnak, after moving the puck back to his defenseman in the neutral zone, winds up gaining speed headed towards the offensive zone. Hampus Lindholm sends the puck down the ice, banking it off the boards towards the net. Pastrnak races to get to it beating the defenseman and shifts it to his backhand before tucking it in for the series clincher.
